response.justification: Candidate meets minimum requirements with 17+ years of software engineering and relevant technical background, but lacks the critical AI/ML strategic expertise this specialized role demands. Recent exposure to AI-agent infrastructure and MCP tooling is encouraging, but the resume shows no evidence of deep AI/ML expertise, strategic AI product development, or customer advisory experience in AI/cloud adoption—all key aspects of this director-level AI Strategy role. Would warrant discussion to assess depth of AI knowledge and strategic thinking, but strong candidates with demonstrated AI expertise would be preferable.
strengths: 17+ years of software engineering experience exceeding the 15-year requirement with progression to Staff-level roles demonstrating technical leadership
Recent exposure to AI-agent infrastructure, MCP code generators, and agentic workflows showing current relevance and commitment to learning modern AI tooling
Strong full-stack capabilities across multiple languages and infrastructure domains with proven ability to architect systems at scale (e.g., millions of HTTP requests/second at Dunnhumby)
concerns: Limited demonstrated AI/ML expertise—recent AI work focuses on infrastructure and tooling rather than AI strategy, machine learning, or AI-powered product development
No advanced degree (Master's/PhD) in AI-related field and no recognized expertise or visibility in the AI domain through publications, products, or speaking engagements
Career progression shows primarily individual contributor and staff engineer roles with no evident strategic advisory or consulting experience advising customers on AI/cloud technology adoption
